newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares close up, boosted by Wolford, OMV.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares close up, boosted by Wolford, OMV.

text.p: 1330 GMT - Austrian shares close higher on Tuesday, pulled up by better than expected first half results from luxury hosiery maker Wolford and a technical rebound by oil and chemicals group OMV. Next target seen at 1,130.
* ATX index up 1.54 points or 0.14 percent at 1,126.12
* December ATX future up 3.2 points at 1,122.7
* Seven ATX shares up, 13 down, one unchanged
* Leading gainer Wolford, up 6.73 percent at 1,214 schillings
* Leading decliner Bank Austria preferred shares, down 2.43 percent at 402 schillings -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112257
